scoring_justification: Full recompute of the 3D drop-and-roll simulation inside the checker is complex, heavy, and its numeric output would differ from the agent's due to algorithmic details; structural checks on coordination number trend (monotonic vs ratio, peak location for optimum fraction) capture the paper's main claims without requiring exact numeric agreement.

outputs.description: Computed coordination number and voidness for each input condition (diameter ratio, large-particle volume fraction).
